protocol.generation: Draw each x independently from the stated masses; draw each label independently Bernoulli(p(x)).
protocol.holdout: One separate 200,000-row holdout per case, generated before any downsampling and never resampled or used to select a fit.
protocol.downsampling: Retain every actual positive; independently retain each actual negative with probability 0.1. Draw 500 new independent masks on the same fixed full dataset after the first representative draw.
protocol.representativeSelection: First draw, specified before fitting; no selection of a favorable run or seed.
protocol.estimator: statsmodels GLM, Binomial family, unpenalized intercept plus x; IRLS maximum 100 iterations and parameter convergence tolerance 1e-10; independent normalized score tolerance 1e-10.
protocol.likelihood: Binary (x,y) records frequency-weighted by actual integer counts, exactly equivalent to fitting all individual rows.
protocol.correction: Add log(0.1) to the sampled intercept; retain the sampled slope.
protocol.uncertainty: Mean and empirical 2.5th/97.5th percentiles of 500 downsampling draws, conditional on one fixed full dataset; these are not uncertainty intervals over newly generated populations.

curved.label: Curved true log odds fitted with a straight line

truth.label: Curved true log odds fitted with a straight line
